The bearer token value shown in the API authentication guide is:

**ns_live_abc123xyz789**

This is shown in the "Using API Keys" section where it demonstrates the Authorization header format:
```
curl -X GET "https://api.northstartech.com/v2/users" \
-H "Authorization: Bearer ns_live_abc123xyz789" \
-H "Content-Type: application/json"
```
